hazards.name: Flooding
hazards.note: Primary hazard: the city sits on the Agno River system and a low-lying plain (elevation ~10-12 m); Agno floodwaters and sustained monsoon/typhoon rainfall.

hazards.name: Typhoons
hazards.note: Pangasinan is typhoon-prone; the inland city is affected by seasonal typhoons.

hazards.name: Earthquakes
hazards.note: Near regional strands of the Philippine Fault System; the city conducts earthquake drills (e.g., BJMP compound, 2023). No local fault map verified.
